name: Kutup Pengueni
scene: An elegant emperor penguin with a golden belly and amber beak stands on ice amid flowing polar sky and ocean bands.
notes: Target 82–122 panes. Penguin uses indigo/gold; sky, ice and water use blue/teal. Gold replaces the original cream to avoid near-white glass. Generated using the fox and lighthouse design sheets as style references and the old penguin as subject reference, then revised once after visual inspection. Final image inspected: closed oval on opaque white exterior, recognizable subject, no apparent loose line ends, improved staggered sky and wave junctions. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists; several same-colour neighbours may merge during tracing, so final pane count is unverified. Narrow beak, feather tips and foot junctions need geometry-stage review; this design sheet is not a stamped geometry audit.
